items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: When we went over to Europe and did that thing with George Wein with the big band?

ctx.x: to Diz a minute. I mean, you know how hot and bothered he got everybody and all the young trumpet players and all the different players? You know, who just felt that what he was doing was just the last word, you know? Well, the groups that he was playing with -- I mean, would you say, in a way, that none of it was really swinging? You know what I mean?

I know it didn't swing. Here's one of the reasons I said they didn't swing. Now look, there was more swinging when he and Bird did something than any other group you ever heard Dizz with. There's Mickey Rok6 -- that's Dizz's number one drummer. When we went over to Europe and did that thing with George Wein with the big band? Mickey couldn't swing that big band. He couldn't swing that big band, you know what I mean?
